$comment: The quarterly Collaborative Continuous Monitoring calendar (CCM-OCR-SOR, CCM-QTR-SAR). Fixed Ongoing Certification Report issue dates, about 3 months apart, placed late in the second month of each quarter (about day 55), away from the beginning, middle and end of the quarter. Each Quarterly Review is a fixed number of business days after its report, counted over the federal holidays listed here. scripts/_ccm.py validates this file (fail-closed) and every report, the CPO and the review calendar file read their dates from it; nothing computes a date from 'now'. Extend the issue dates and holidays before the calendar runs out: the build fails when fewer than two issue dates lie ahead.
rationale: Issue on a Tuesday late in each quarter's middle month: a fixed, predictable cycle that is spread out from the start, middle and end of each quarter, as CCM-OCR-SOR asks. The review follows 5 business days later, inside the 3-to-10 business day window of CCM-QTR-SAR, leaving time to read the report first.

holidays.source: U.S. federal holidays (5 U.S.C. 6103), observed dates
